install_redcap.description: Check or interactively prepare the RedCap workspace and accept it with a clean 1 UE smoke.

input.mode: No argument for interactive installation, --check for read-only preflight, or --help.
input.REDCAP_INSTALL_MIN_FREE_GB: Optional minimum free-space threshold; defaults to 40 GiB and may only raise the documented baseline.

output.log_path: Timestamped test_log/compiler_logs/redcap_install_*.log for an accepted interactive run.
output.exit_code: Zero only when the selected check or workflow completes.
output.status_field: task_log/tasks.json status for the interactive preparation and 1 UE smoke.

install_redcap.side_effects: --check and --help are read-only. Interactive mode may install uv, synchronize .venv, run the upstream OAI dependency installer, pull images, build project-local RedCap images and the declared FlexRIC service, start and stop installer-owned Compose services, and write logs.

rebuild_local_redcap_images.description: Build ran-build, oai-aiotf, oai-gnb, and oai-nr-ue local images from the current workspace.

input.REDCAP_REBUILD_RAN_BASE: Set to 1 to rebuild ran-base instead of reusing it when present.
input.REDCAP_DOCKER_NO_CACHE: Set to 1 to disable Docker build cache.
input.REDCAP_BUILD_OPTION: Optional build argument forwarded to the existing Docker build contract.

output.exit_code: Docker build process exit code.

rebuild_local_redcap_images.side_effects: Builds or replaces local ran-base, ran-build, oai-aiotf, oai-gnb, and oai-nr-ue images; does not start containers or edit source files.

mmtc_menu.description: Open the RedCap mMTC operator menu or dispatch a supported subcommand.

input.MMTC_ACTIVE_UES: Comma or whitespace separated UE indices in the supported range 1 through 56.

output.exit_code: Process exit code.
output.status_field: Caller-managed task_log/tasks.json status for long subcommands.

mmtc_menu.side_effects: Help is read-only; install and runtime subcommands may prepare dependencies, pull or build images, start or stop Docker services, and write logs.

generate_mmtc_cn_db_overlay.description: Generate an idempotent CN5G subscriber SQL seed and Compose override.

input.total_ues: Supported UE count, 1 through 56 for the current runtime contract.

output.exit_code: Process exit code.

generate_mmtc_cn_db_overlay.side_effects: Writes only the requested SQL and Compose override files.

validate_cn5g_clean_seed.description: Validate the repository-owned CN5G base and UE1..UE56 seed in an isolated clean MySQL instance.

output.exit_code: Process exit code.

validate_cn5g_clean_seed.side_effects: Creates and removes one uniquely named temporary MySQL container; does not attach to or modify existing containers or volumes.

mmtc_smoke_validation.description: Run tracked CN5G and RFsim validation for the selected active UE set.

input.MMTC_ACTIVE_UES: Comma or whitespace separated UE indices in the supported range 1 through 56.

output.exit_code: Process exit code.

mmtc_smoke_validation.side_effects: Starts and stops Docker Compose services and writes runtime logs; does not edit source files.

validate_redcap_interface.description: Run syntax, path, help, generator, and active-UE boundary checks for the RedCap operator interface.

output.exit_code: Process exit code.

validate_redcap_interface.side_effects: Creates and removes only validation-owned temporary files; does not start Docker services.

validate_redcap_public_docs.description: Validate required bilingual public docs, routes, encoding, and 29 UE acceptance markers.

output.exit_code: Process exit code.

validate_redcap_public_docs.side_effects: Read-only documentation and path checks; does not start Docker services.

validate_redcap_research_wiki.description: Validate the RedCap research wiki structure, metadata, source paths, index membership, local links, evidence labels, and activity log.

output.exit_code: Zero only when every required wiki contract passes.

validate_redcap_research_wiki.side_effects: Read-only Markdown and path checks; does not edit wiki pages, source files, or runtime state.

validate_dapp_xapp_sdk_docs.description: Run the project static source, documentation, path, and evidence-contract checker.

output.exit_code: Process exit code.

validate_dapp_xapp_sdk_docs.side_effects: Read-only static checks; does not start Docker services.

selftest_dapp_xapp_sdk_contract.description: Run the Python dApp/xApp SDK contract self-test.

output.exit_code: Process exit code.

selftest_dapp_xapp_sdk_contract.side_effects: Read-only self-test; does not start Docker services.

validate_redcap_oran_sdk_workflow_v3.description: Run the RedCap O-RAN SDK Workflow 3.0 static documentation, contract, and source checks.

output.exit_code: Process exit code.

validate_redcap_oran_sdk_workflow_v3.side_effects: Read-only static checks; does not start Docker services.

aiot_tag_selftest.description: Run the existing deterministic Tag/CW/R2D/D2R boundary self-test.

output.exit_code: Zero only when AIOT_T2_SELF_TEST PASS is produced.

aiot_tag_selftest.side_effects: Read-only execution of the existing replay_node self-test; does not start services.

aiotf_inventory_selftest.description: Run the existing bounded 60-Tag AIOTF inventory state self-test.

output.exit_code: Zero only when AIOTF_INVENTORY_TEST PASS is produced.

aiotf_inventory_selftest.side_effects: Read-only execution of the existing AIOTF inventory test; does not start services.

aiot_topology2_runtime.description: Run the existing tracked RFsim Topology 2 experiment through the mMTC smoke owner.

input.MMTC_ACTIVE_UES: One reader UE or the declared reader/observer UE set.
input.MMTC_UE_EXTRA_OPTIONS: Validated reader or observer role, Tag, wake window, reader handle, and experimental report endpoint.

output.exit_code: Existing smoke workflow exit code.

aiot_topology2_runtime.side_effects: Starts and recreates the declared CN5G/RFsim services, writes runtime logs, and executes its existing cleanup trap; it does not edit source files or remove volumes.

aiot_evidence_check.description: Validate retained Tag, AIOTF, single-reader, two-reader, or serialized-60 evidence markers.

input.kind: tag, aiotf, single_reader, two_reader, or serialized_60.
input.log_path: Existing regular file resolving below repository test_log/.

output.exit_code: Zero only when every kind-specific marker is present.

aiot_evidence_check.side_effects: Read-only marker validation; rejects paths outside test_log and does not start services.

aiot_topology2_cleanup.description: Return the existing mMTC CN5G/RFsim experiment to its stopped state without deleting volumes.

input.subcommand: Fixed value down; invoke only for a stack started by aiot_topology2_runtime.

output.exit_code: Menu down exit code; repeated calls are accepted.

aiot_topology2_cleanup.side_effects: Stops existing CN5G/RFsim Compose services and removes orphans without deleting volumes; this is experiment cleanup, not the later AIOTF-only down operation.

aiot_operator.description: Validate, start, inspect, or stop only the disabled-by-default oai-aiotf Compose service.

input.action: operator followed by validate, start, status, or down.
input.AIOTF_TRANSPORT_PROFILE: Must be experimental_n6; unsupported SBI and NEF profiles fail closed.
input.AIOTF_TAGS: Optional unique comma-separated Tag IDs 1 through 60.

output.log_path: Caller-selected log; long start/build operations require task_log/tasks.json.
output.exit_code: Zero only when the requested lifecycle operation completes.
output.status_field: Caller-managed task_log/tasks.json status for long operations.

aiot_operator.side_effects: validate and status are read-only. start may build/start oai-aiotf. down stops and removes only oai-aiotf; no command removes volumes or mutates other CN5G services.

aiot_topology2_demo.description: Run the fixed Tag25 two-reader experimental_n6 diagnostic demonstration and clean up only oai-aiotf.

output.exit_code: Zero only after first-valid, duplicate-evidence, and rejected-slot markers are observed.

aiot_topology2_demo.side_effects: Starts and removes only oai-aiotf, sends three localhost UDP reports, reads its logs, and preserves all CN5G volumes and other services.

build_aiotf_nrf_candidate.description: Build the owner-local OAI NRF AIOTF schema candidate with the official NRF Dockerfile.

input.NRF_SOURCE_DIR: Authorized OAI NRF source checkout containing docker/Dockerfile.nrf.ubuntu.
input.NRF_CANDIDATE_IMAGE: Optional local image tag; defaults to oai-nrf:aiotf-ts29510-v19.6.0.
input.NRF_CONFORMANCE_TARGET: Optional isolated or deployed; deployed probes the running Compose NRF without starting another container.

output.exit_code: Official Docker build exit code.

build_aiotf_nrf_candidate.side_effects: Builds or replaces only the declared local NRF candidate image; does not start containers or edit source files.

validate_aiotf_nrf_candidate.description: Run isolated AIOTF lifecycle, boundary, discovery, concurrency, legacy-NF, and cleanup checks against the NRF candidate.

input.NRF_CANDIDATE_IMAGE: Optional local image tag; defaults to oai-nrf:aiotf-ts29510-v19.6.0.

output.exit_code: Zero only when AIOT_NRF_CONFORMANCE PASS is produced after cleanup.

validate_aiotf_nrf_candidate.side_effects: Starts and removes one labeled candidate NRF container, creates and deletes unique in-memory test profiles, and preserves CN5G containers and volumes.

probe_nrf_legacy_baseline.description: Run the AMF lifecycle and discovery control against the currently deployed NRF and clean its unique profile.

output.exit_code: Zero only when AIOT_NRF_LEGACY_BASELINE PASS is produced after cleanup.

probe_nrf_legacy_baseline.side_effects: Creates and deletes one unique in-memory AMF test profile in the running NRF; does not recreate containers or change volumes.

validate_aiotf_nrf_client.description: Validate the AIOTF HTTP/2 NRF client lifecycle and readiness dependency against the deployed upgraded NRF.

input.AIOTF_CLIENT_IMAGE: Optional local AIOTF image; defaults to oai-aiotf:latest.

output.log_path: Timestamped protocol evidence path declared in task_log/tasks.json.
output.exit_code: Zero only after all seven client boundaries pass and cleanup is empty.

validate_aiotf_nrf_client.side_effects: Starts and removes four fixed labeled AIOTF test containers on public_net, creates and deletes one fixed test NFProfile, and preserves CN5G containers and volumes.

validate_aiotf_naiotf_inventory.description: Validate the bounded trusted-AF Naiotf Inventory HTTP/2 request, rejection, timeout-notification, and restart boundaries.

input.AIOTF_CLIENT_IMAGE: Optional local AIOTF image; defaults to oai-aiotf:latest.

output.log_path: Timestamped protocol evidence path declared in task_log/tasks.json.
output.exit_code: Zero only after h2c 0/1/60/61 Tag, authorization, callback 204, restart, and cleanup boundaries pass.

validate_aiotf_naiotf_inventory.side_effects: Starts and removes three fixed labeled AIOTF test containers on public_net, creates and deletes one fixed test NFProfile, and preserves CN5G containers and volumes.

redcap_drl_xapp.description: Create and operate a gated DRL xApp Docker workspace without mutating the existing simulator compose project.

input.command: init, up, verify, discover-kpm, qualify-kpm, freeze-measurement-post, run, status, recover, down, remove, build-release, upgrade, or --help.
input.workspace: Command-specific workspace path or init workspace root and name.
input.compose: Explicit existing FlexRIC RedCap Compose file; required by init and never modified.
input.runtime: cpu or gpu; locked at init.
input.profile: none or ul-prb-cap-v1; locked at init.

output.log_path: Workspace artifacts/runs/<run-id>/manifest.json and caller-selected tracked build/runtime log.
output.exit_code: Zero only when the requested gate or lifecycle action completes.
output.status_field: Caller-managed task_log/tasks.json status for image builds and live runtime operations.

redcap_drl_xapp.side_effects: Help and status are read-only. init writes one new workspace atomically. build-release builds immutable local images. up/run/down/remove affect only generated workspace services; live E2 control is refused unless every profile gate passes.

test_redcap_drl_xapp.description: Run the frozen DRL xApp public CLI and bridge refusal-path unit tests.

output.exit_code: Zero only when every DRL xApp refusal-path test passes.

test_redcap_drl_xapp.side_effects: Creates and removes only test-owned temporary files; does not contact Docker, subscribe to KPM, or send E2 control.
